_: Readings behind the fleet run's shell. `shellpty.py` forks each case onto a pty set up
exactly as `kampr_fleet::exec::Supervisor::spawn` sets one up — setsid AND TIOCSCTTY — and
samples the master's termios and the /proc state of the whole tree.
Machine: comingclean, bash 5.x, ble.sh installed and sourced from ~/.bashrc.

the password signal, with a shell in fro.no shell, getpass: ECHO OFF, ICANON on; python3 parked in read(fd 3 -> /dev/tty)
the password signal, with a shell in fro.bash -c 'read -s': ECHO OFF, ICANON on; bash parked in read(fd 0 -> /dev/pts/N)
the password signal, with a shell in fro.bash -c 'true && getpass': ECHO OFF, ICANON on; one process, bash exec'd it
the password signal, with a shell in fro.bash -c 'su -': ECHO OFF, ICANON on; syscall <EPERM 13>, as #339 says
the password signal, with a shell in fro.bash -c idle (cat, sleep): ECHO on, ICANON on — NOT a secret
the password signal, with a shell in fro.bash -i idle at its own prompt: ECHO OFF, ICANON OFF — this is #333, and it needs -i
the password signal, with a shell in fro.bash -lic 'sleep 30': ECHO on, ICANON on — a -c invocation is not a line-editing prompt
the password signal, with a shell in fro.BLE_VERSION under bash -c: unset; $- reads `hBc`, no `i`, so .bashrc returns at its guard
the password signal, with a shell in fro.BLE_VERSION under bash -ic on a pty: STILL unset — ble.sh sets _ble_init_exit=1 when BASH_EXECUTION_STRING is set (/usr/share/blesh/ble.sh:143), so it declines to load into ANY -c invocation

the process tree, and whose fd 0 is the.bash -c 'cat': one pid [cat], WAITING on fd 0 -> /dev/pts/N. bash exec'd it
the process tree, and whose fd 0 is the.bash -c 'true && cat': one pid [cat] — an && chain of simple commands is still exec'd
the process tree, and whose fd 0 is the.bash -c 'cat | cat': bash in wait4 (busy), cat #1 WAITING on fd 0 -> /dev/pts/N, cat #2 WAITING on fd 0 -> pipe:[…]
the process tree, and whose fd 0 is the.bash -c 'sleep 30 | cat': bash in wait4, sleep busy, cat WAITING on fd 0 -> pipe:[…] — NOBODY holds the terminal, and rung 1 keyed on the syscall alone calls this host a question
the process tree, and whose fd 0 is the.bash -c 'sleep 30 & cat': bash in wait4, sleep busy, cat WAITING on fd 0 -> /dev/pts/N
the process tree, and whose fd 0 is the.bash -c 'sleep 30 & wait': bash in wait4, sleep busy — correctly no question

the PATH each invocation answers, from e.bash -lc: + ~/.local/bin, flatpak, jvm, perl, rustup, JetBrains Toolbox
the PATH each invocation answers, from e.bash -ic: ~/.local/bin, ~/.nvm/versions/node/v24.5.0/bin, ~/go/bin, ~/dev/houseofdoge/hod-scripts, Android SDK cmake + emulator, then the system three
the PATH each invocation answers, from e.cost, median of 5: -lc 107 ms, -ic 176 ms, -lic 398 ms (max 513 ms). Paid once per node process.
the PATH each invocation answers, from e.stderr of an interactive read with no tt: `cannot set terminal process group`, `no job control in this shell`, `stty: standard input` — discarded; stdout was clean and the NUL markers hold either way
